native_process_policy: One model training/export parity/generation process at a time
training_source_change_policy: Freeze all scientific sources and executable hashes before before arm; same bindings for after arm
archive_timeout_rationale: A saved checkpoint has about53.4MB of matrix/adapter payload; upload plus fresh pinned readback moves at least106.8MB. Both arms receive the same15minute acknowledgement deadline; transport failures terminate immediately. No training mathematics or update schedule changes.
